F13.1.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN tbl_zeta_e1_shipped_on_n2."COL_BRAVO_W9" = 3 THEN transactionslogv9."NET_AMT_DOL_J8" END::FLOAT)
F13.1.title: USERELATIONSHIP on the inactive date path
F13.1.solution: Emit each inactive relationship as an alias of the dimension named '<Dim> <FK column>' (here calendar_ship_date) joined on that FK; USERELATIONSHIP(...) switches the filter to that alias.

F13.2.sql: COUNT(CASE WHEN tbl_zeta_e1_shipped_on_n2."COL_BRAVO_W9" = 1 THEN transactionslogv9.ITEM_KEY_X3 END)
F13.2.title: USERELATIONSHIP with a row count
F13.2.solution: Same alias rule; counts use COUNT(CASE WHEN ... THEN key END) with no ELSE.

F13.3.sql: COUNT(CASE WHEN tblzetae1."COL_BRAVO_W9" = 1 THEN transactionslogv9.ITEM_KEY_X3 END)
F13.3.title: without USERELATIONSHIP the ACTIVE path is used
F13.3.solution: The alias must not change measures that do not ask for it.

F13.4.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN tbl_zeta_z6_col_orbit_j9."COL_ZETA_X9" = 3 THEN transactionslogv9."NET_AMT_DOL_J8" END::FLOAT)
F13.4.title: USERELATIONSHIP with special characters in dim and FK
F13.4.solution: inactive_alias sanitizes '&', '%', '$' and spaces via IdentifierSanitizer.
